answer: Each identity enters a walnut-shelled audit pool where, first, the protocol draws a fresh seed from a river of entropy that authors cannot predict; the author must then re-derive its prior answer under that seed, streaming every intermediate token, not just the verdict. A juniper-scented challenge log timestamps each reasoning step, and verifiers replay the trace, checking that the token path reproduces the same conclusion and that the work rate matches a plausible model.
